overview: The Lexus RX is the brand's best-selling midsize luxury crossover, redesigned for 2023. The electrified variants for 2025-2026 include the RX 350h (hybrid), RX 450h+ (PHEV), and RX 500h F SPORT Performance (high-output hybrid). Built on the TNGA-K platform. Sources: https://www.lexus.com/models/RX , https://pressroom.lexus.com/2023-lexus-rx/
